summary: Implemented the Databricks OAuth profile mapping. Added cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py with DatabricksOauthProfileMapping (required fields host, schema, client_secret, client_id, http_path; secret fields client_id and client_secret; airflow mapping with login/password as first sources and extra fallbacks; profile built as mapped params, then profile args, then auth_type oauth, then env-var references for both secrets). Registered it in cosmos/profiles/databricks/__init__.py and cosmos/profiles/__init__.py (import, ordered-list entry directly after the token mapping, and exports). Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py covering claim, token-over-OAuth selection, OAuth selection, profile output, profile-arg overrides, and env vars. Nothing was run, per instructions; the tests are unverified and running pytest on tests/profiles/databricks is the next step. No commits were made.
